title: Liouville Theory from the Virasoro Conformal Net
exact_target: Identify the field theory produced by the source conformal-net construction with Liouville theory.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006635 (OWR-14299913-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Higher Structures from Symmetries in Quantum Field Theory (2026), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2026/12, pp. 737--794. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: For a nonrational net the source construction is defined on the subcategory whose connected surface components have nonempty incoming and outgoing boundaries. An extension to every conformal bordism is not silently assumed.
